% Source of two_page_sizes.pdf: `pdftex -no-shell-escape two_page_sizes.tex` (TeX Live 2025): page 1 is
% 300x100 bp, page 2 is 100x300 bp, each filled by a rule of its own size; the guard is
% graphics::tests::vector_svg_of_page_two_is_page_two.
\pdfcompresslevel=9 \pdfobjcompresslevel=2
\pdfinfoomitdate=1 \pdftrailerid{} \pdfsuppressptexinfo=-1
\pdfpagewidth=300bp \pdfpageheight=100bp
\hoffset=-1in \voffset=-1in
\topskip=0pt \parindent=0pt \parskip=0pt
\nopagenumbers
\vsize=100bp \hsize=300bp
\noindent\vrule width 300bp height 100bp depth 0pt
\vfill\eject
\pdfpagewidth=100bp \pdfpageheight=300bp
\vsize=300bp \hsize=100bp
\noindent\vrule width 100bp height 300bp depth 0pt
\vfill\eject
\bye
